svg.title: A classical call from its submission to its answer
svg.desc: Timeline of feed_forward on a drive line, a readout line and the gpu link. The readout ends at 500 ns and decode is submitted then; the request holds the link for 102.5 ns, the answer has a timeout of 4000 ns and 50 ns of feedback, and it is due at 4652.5 ns, 4152.5 ns after its submission, where the correction pulse starts, dashed because it plays only on some outcomes. A second panel shows 4502.5 to 4722.5 ns closer: the end of the timeout, the feedback and the pulse.
